slot_keys.engine_check: iteration 6 slot_key (iter5E, T1, W, k) for k in 0-9

design.sampling: inverse-CDF CRN, fp32 logits, float64 CDF in token-id order; top-k = mask below the row's k-th largest logit

das.loss: sum_k KL(q_s || q'_k) over {B, D, O}

decision_rules.ENGINE_CHECK: Pass if the twin BFS share (N=50, natural sampling T=1 top-p 1) lies inside iteration 6's Wilson 95% CI [0.245, 0.372] for 61/200; per-slot label agreement with iteration 6's rows is reported whatever it is.
decision_rules.U6: 200 continuations from the empty response prefix: (a) fork-resampling path (multi-prompt batches, partial labeller; also labelled with the full labeller) and (b) the main single-prompt fixed-shape engine; each is compared with the natural share (two-proportion exact test). Diagnosis: labeller (a-partial vs a-full), batching ((a) vs (b)), or neither.
decision_rules.G3_SOURCE_RULE: PRIMARY P(BFS | t) for t in B and D is iteration 6's token table UNLESS the U6 diagnosis shows that path (a) differs from (b) at p < 0.05; then the primary is the G3-cal estimate. The other source is reported as the sensitivity.
decision_rules.NODE_CLAIM: Holm p < 0.05 (exact one-sided sign-flip permutation over the 20 variant prompts, Holm over the top 10) AND the median d_i is in the expected direction AND joint top-5 beats >= 95% of its random sets on the median over prompts.
decision_rules.G2_DAS_REAL: At some k <= 8 (seed median), DAS recovery - RAND recovery >= 0.4 (paired Wilcoxon over held-out pairs, p < 0.01) AND SHUF held-out recovery <= 0.1 AND RINIT held-out effect < 0.5 x the trained model's effect in nats.
decision_rules.ONE_DIMENSIONAL_WORDING: only if k=1 recovery >= 0.8 AND Spearman(R_1^T h_v, y_v) >= 0.5 (p < 0.01) AND G2-KNOB holds; otherwise 'a rank-k subspace carries the forced-prompt transfer'.
decision_rules.DORMANT_FLAG: share_k at or below the 95th percentile of random AND |Spearman| < 0.2.
decision_rules.K_STAR: the smallest k whose train-CV recovery >= 0.9 x the maximum over k.
decision_rules.G2_KNOB: some BFS-direction dose has correct-BFS > the twin's (exact one-sided McNemar on CRN pairs, Holm over the 6 doses of that method, p < 0.05) AND pass >= 0.8 x the twin's pass; evaluated for DAS and DiM separately.
decision_rules.G3_LAW: |pred - obs| <= 0.10 in every top-p-1 cell (top-k cells reported separately).
decision_rules.G3_DISCONFIRMED: H > 0.5 bits or any top-p-1 cell misses by more than 0.2.

drop_order: G1 generation beyond 5 nodes (top-10 and DFS arms)
the random-init control at the second layer
the DFS-direction DiM cells (keep DAS toward DFS at 0.2 / 0.5 / 1)
never_drop: G1 (graph or G1-P) validated in the real model on the teacher-forced margin
G2 with RAND, SHUF, RINIT at L*, held-out templates, the natural-variance check and the BFS-direction dose sweep for DAS and DiM
G3 at top-p 1 with its committed predictions
